name: canals-dev
description: Dev-only tooling and quality gate for the Canals Civ VII mod. Not shipped.

scripts.check: node --check ui/canals.js && node --check ui/canals-settings.js && node --check ui/canals-options.js && node --check ui/canals-shell.js
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run check && npm run pedia && npm run i18n && npm run rules
scripts.test: node --test tests/i18n.test.mjs tests/canal-rules.test.mjs && npm run pedia
